_meta.description: Complete S.5 reference standards finding for Valsartan (USP 47). All IPRP sub-items (a)–(d) are documented: lot number, CoA, overlaid IR spectra, working standard qualification, and source. Mirrors the SCoRE fixed-dose combination dossier pattern for the Valsartan API. QA/Critic R4–R6 all pass; qa_status must be PASS. Added following Fix D which introduced USP/Valsartan mock records.

findings.rationale: Sponsor claims USP 47 Reference Standard for Valsartan. Lot number USP-VAL-2024-R047 is provided. Certificate of analysis (CoA) submitted. Overlaid IR spectra of the USP RS and Valsartan drug substance batch submitted confirming identity. Working standard WS-VAL-LAB-011 qualified against USP RS lot USP-VAL-2024-R047. Source of standards: purchased from United States Pharmacopeia.
findings.evidence_snippet: Lot no. USP-VAL-2024-R047. CoA submitted. Overlaid IR spectra consistent. Working standard WS-VAL-LAB-011 traceability confirmed. Source: USP.

findings.note: All IPRP S.5 sub-item text indicators present: lot number, CoA, IR spectra (overlaid), working standard, source. R4–R6 all pass. R7 does not fire. PASS.
